item.title: Aug 2026 reading
item.description:
In my quest to read more books, I’m making this page to have some accountability on actually reading shit, & to briefly share my thoughts.

Currently reading

Antimemetics: Why Some Ideas Resist Spreading, Nadia Asparouhova, theory/philosophy

Completed

Ancillary Justice

Ann Leckie, scifi, 03 Aug 2026
I highly recommend this one. This was a reread; it held up very well, though I’m a known sucker for a living weapon. Excellent science fiction that actually knows when it’s saying some Fascist Bullshit, and, as far as I read it, is doing it critically.
